The hackathon challenges participants to transform data into meaningful insights, intelligent solutions, and real-world innovations using Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and Visualization . Participants will work on real-world challenges, analyze datasets, identify patterns and opportunities, develop data-driven solutions, and present their work to a panel of tech experts and industry professionals. Prizes & Opportunities ₹25,000 Cash Prize Pool Internship + Interview Opportunities Certificates for Participants Dinner & Refreshments Event Details Team Size: 4–6 Members Date: 7–8 October 2026 Duration: 24 Hours Venue: MG Auditorium, VIT Chennai DATA QUEST 3.0 Build with Data. raw.details:
DATA QUEST 3.0

WHERE DATA MEETS DESTINY.

24 HOURS. BUILD. COMPETE. CONQUER.

Data Quest 3.0 is a 24-hour data-driven hackathon organized by the Engagement & Collaboration Committee of Data Science (ECDS), VIT Chennai.

The hackathon challenges participants to transform data into meaningful insights, intelligent solutions, and real-world innovations using Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and Visualization.

Participants will work on real-world challenges, analyze datasets, identify patterns and opportunities, develop data-driven solutions, and present their work to a panel of tech experts and industry professionals.

What to Expect

  • Analyze and interpret real-world datasets

  • Identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities

  • Develop Machine Learning and AI-powered solutions

  • Build interactive dashboards and visualizations

  • Create functional prototypes and MVPs

  • Validate solutions using data-driven approaches

  • Present and communicate findings effectively

Areas of Exploration

Participants can explore challenges across domains such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

  • Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Finance

  • Healthcare

  • Sustainability

  • Education

  • Social Development

  • Business & Technology

  • Other real-world data-driven challenges

Participants are encouraged to leverage modern AI/ML frameworks, analytics tools, visualization platforms, cloud technologies, and open datasets to build innovative and scalable solutions.

Prizes & Opportunities

₹25,000 Cash Prize Pool

Internship + Interview Opportunities

Certificates for Participants

Dinner & Refreshments

Event Details

Team Size: 4–6 Members
Date: 7–8 October 2026
Duration: 24 Hours
Venue: MG Auditorium, VIT Chennai

DATA QUEST 3.0

Build with Data. Discover Insights. Create Impact.
